Answer in exactly 2-4 lines, in plain language. If you need a chart and you have the data, include exactly one.I can confirm the 536g daily gain for CPT Castro 2 in the 25 July – 24 August 30-day block is **incorrect / mathematically misleading** on the dashboard.

The actual whole-pen averages recorded for Castro 2 in that window were normal: 22.5 kg on 27 July, growing to 24.3 kg by 10 August, and 26.9 kg by 24 August. The highest true span gain was **186 g/day** (from 10 to 24 August).
